Population Covered (Dose 01).db_query_template: SELECT {db_id_column} FROM {db_table} pt JOIN {project_table} p ON pt.projectid = p.id WHERE pt.status = '{status}' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(pt.additionaldetails->'fields') f WHERE f->>'key' = 'doseIndex' AND f->>'value' = '{dose}' ) AND p.projecttypeid = '{projectTypeId}' AND p.projecthierarchy ILIKE '{projectHierarchy}' AND pt.isdeleted = false

Population Covered (Dose 02).db_query_template: SELECT {db_id_column} FROM {db_table} pt JOIN {project_table} p ON pt.projectid = p.id WHERE pt.status = '{status}' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(pt.additionaldetails->'fields') f WHERE f->>'key' = 'doseIndex' AND f->>'value' = '{dose}' ) AND p.projecttypeid = '{projectTypeId}' AND p.projecthierarchy ILIKE '{projectHierarchy}' AND pt.isdeleted = false

Beneficiary Covered.db_query_template: SELECT {db_id_column} FROM {db_table} pt WHERE pt.status IN ({status_list}) AND pt.isdeleted = false

Number of Deliveries.db_query_template: SELECT {db_id_column} FROM {db_table} pt WHERE pt.status = '{status}' AND pt.isdeleted = false

Stock Received (Quantity).db_query_template: SELECT s.clientreferenceid, s.quantity FROM {stock_table} s JOIN {facility_table} f ON s.receiverid = f.id JOIN {project_table} p ON s.referenceid = p.id WHERE s.transactiontype = '{transactionType}' AND f.usage = '{facilityType}' AND p.projecttypeid = '{projectTypeId}' AND p.projecthierarchy ILIKE '{projectHierarchy}' AND s.isdeleted = false
